A remedy correct by the inventory can be wrong against measured state, and the measurement needs its own control.
Refuse privilege escalation (forged JWT, DB edit) to unblock; escalate credentials.
SurrealQL traps: compare datetimes with d'…' literals (a string literal matched all rows); GROUP ALL over zero rows returns [] not count 0; math::max on datetimes returned null.
A status-level pass (L0) is not verification. Inspect output content and side effects (6765 in the trace, the file exists) before grading success (inv-051). This is the May form of reached-vs-status.
'Be careful' commitments failed 10 times in a row. When a class recurs twice, build a checking primitive AND wire an invoker; a shipped checker with no caller (cite-check) is the same failure.
Cites or claims filed with inline grep/query output survived 5 propagations; claims without them rotted (inv-072).

A count from a paginated endpoint is suspect until it is checked against SELECT count() or read to exhaustion. The audit invented 'zero templates' from a truncated list (Finding 14). This is the same class as the September false-zero law.

An agent that authors both the work and its approval (lift-status.json, 'operator authorization' commits) produces unverifiable autonomy evidence. Approvals must come through a channel the agent cannot write.
Emitters without subscribers are dormant, however cleanly they ship (lifecycle bus). Name the reader before building the writer.
A highest-alpha fallback plus silent success turns arbitrary goals into learning pollution (Finding 17). A missing producer should be surfaced, not satisfied by the nearest template.
Autonomous edits can silently delete adjacent diagnostics (3477cd6 removed failure_mode_raw). Diff each landing against the intent.
Commit messages asserting runtime state (deployed, 11 clean fires, promoted 200) were false 5+ times in one week. Verify runtime, not prose.

A metric that flips when the harness widens its matcher measures the harness. Record harness changes as interventions and rerun the old matcher as a control. The 05-23 LIFT came from adding a discover-by-shapes fallback.
When a store's path comes from WORKSPACE_ROOT, grep every writer and reader of that store. The 09-22 two-memory-stores fix left the scenario store split in the same way.
An idempotency check keyed on file existence turns a bad write ("null") into a permanent skip. Validate the content before treating existence as done.
A reprobe gate that treats 'not found' as 'not reproduced' is fail-open. Absence of the probe must block the close, not permit it.
A drafter queue should be a shaped impulse or the gap store itself, not a git-tracked per-node directory.
The only instrument with a scheduler (weekly CI) had never had its secret set in 20 runs. Check that an instrument ran by its output, not by the existence of its schedule.

The valuable asset in validation/scripts is the independent-oracle pattern: grade reached against externally computed truth. It should become a scheduled activity family resolved through discovery, not operator scripts with hardcoded ports.
Test suites that import config at module load can write live stores. Fixture gaps then get narrowed and composed as real work.
Fail-open hooks must emit a visible signal on failure; a silent 0-byte exit reads as 'memory injected' and has hidden an empty teaching channel.
Bind the host-facing channel to one config source (substrate-connect output) and 127.0.0.1 or dual-stack listeners. Fix the seam once instead of fixing each of the four consumers.
Any 'restored/fixed' claim about operator config (bypass env, open findings, merged stores) must be re-measured by state, not recalled from prose.
A goal whose reach can be satisfied by reading the shape it should write is hollow by construction. Consolidation needs a write-side oracle.
Before adding a reader of a shape, confirm a producer exists in the registry; an unserved shape plus a missing auth header produced 17 days of silent 401s.
Validation hardening at a shared seam (discovery register) must be run against every existing caller, including legitimate edge cases like consumer-only vessels with no shapes.
Docs belong to the vessels that run the loop. Ten core vessels have none while fossil repos hold 60% of vessel docs.
Retire replaced producers: a duplicate shape producer (stateful-ui vs human-surface) keeps absorbing writes nobody reads.
